description: For fixed relation domains, individual assignments agreeing on the free individual names of \(\varphi\), and relation assignments agreeing extensionally on its free relation names, give \(\varphi\) the same truth value.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.realize_agree.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] (D : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.RelationDomains M)
  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.Formula L) (a b : ℕ → M)
  (r s : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.RelationAssignment M)
  (hi : ∀ x ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.freeIndividual φ, a x = b x)
  (hr : ∀ p ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.freeRelation φ, r p.1 p.2 = s p.1 p.2) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.realize D a r φ ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.realize D b s φ
